class.name: OctahedralImpostorBaker
class.brief_description: Bakes the views of a node into the atlases of an octahedral impostor, or into the textures of a billboard (editor only).
class.description:
Renders a node and its visible descendants and packs the views into textures, depending on [member type]: - [constant TYPE_OCTAHEDRAL_IMPOSTOR]: the views from [member frames] × [member frames] directions, in the atlases of an [OctahedralImpostorMaterial3D]. - [constant TYPE_BILLBOARD]: a single view from the front of the object (the [code]+Z[/code] side) for a quad that turns toward the camera, or one view per plane for crossed planes (see [member billboard_mode]), drawn with a [StandardMaterial3D] in billboard mode. The editor uses it for the [b]Create Octahedral Impostor[/b] and [b]Create Billboard[/b] dialogs (context menus of the Scene and FileSystem docks), it can also be used by editor scripts, e.g. to bake many objects at once: [codeblock] var baker = OctahedralImpostorBaker.new() baker.frames = 16 baker.atlas_size = 2048 for tree in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("trees"): if baker.bake(tree) == OK: baker.save("res://impostors/%s.tres" % tree.name.to_snake_case())
# Billboards of the bushes. baker.type = OctahedralImpostorBaker.TYPE_BILLBOARD baker.billboard_mode = OctahedralImpostorBaker.BILLBOARD_CROSS baker.atlas_size = 512 for bush in get_tree().get_nodes_in_group("bushes"): if baker.bake(bush) == OK: baker.save("res://billboards/%s.tres" % bush.name.to_snake_case()) [/codeblock] The baked geometry is the one of the [MeshInstance3D], [MultiMeshInstance3D] and root [CSGShape3D] nodes, with their materials (including [ShaderMaterial]s), material overrides and overlays, blend shapes and instance shader parameters. Hidden nodes, geometry that only casts shadows, far levels of detail ([member GeometryInstance3D.visibility_range_begin] greater than [code]0[/code]), impostors and baked billboards are skipped. The views are rendered with the renderer of the editor, the views of a region of the textures in a single draw, and supersampled. The albedo is the unshaded color of the materials. With the Forward+ renderer, the normals and the depth are read from the buffers of the renderer, so they include the normal maps and the custom shaders of all the materials. With the other renderers, and for the ORM textures, the materials are replaced by materials with their parameters: all the parameters of [BaseMaterial3D], and the usual parameter names of [ShaderMaterial]s ([code]albedo[/code], [code]texture_albedo[/code], [code]alpha_scissor_threshold[/code], [code]texture_normal[/code], [code]roughness[/code], [code]metallic[/code]...). The empty pixels of each view are filled with the colors of their neighbors, so that filtering and mipmaps don't bring in the background.

method.name: bake
method.description: Bakes the atlases of the impostor, or the textures of the billboard, of [param node], which must be a [Node3D]. The node doesn't have to be inside the scene tree, except for [CSGShape3D] nodes. The views are in the space of the node: the impostor or the billboard has the transform of the node (without its own transform). If [param show_progress] is [code]true[/code], a progress dialog is shown, which allows to cancel the bake ([constant ERR_SKIP] is returned then).

method.name: create_material
method.description: Returns a new material with the result of the last bake of an octahedral impostor, with [ImageTexture]s of the atlases. Useful for previews: use [method save] to create the resources of an impostor. See also [method create_mesh].

method.name: create_mesh
method.description: Returns a new mesh with the result of the last bake (an octahedral impostor or a billboard), with [ImageTexture]s of the textures. Useful for previews: use [method save] to create the resources of an impostor or a billboard.

method.name: get_albedo_image
method.description: Returns the albedo atlas of the last bake: color and coverage.

method.name: get_frame_size
method.description: Returns the size in pixels of a frame of the atlas of an octahedral impostor with the current settings: [member atlas_size] divided by [member frames], rounded down to a multiple of 4 (the size of the blocks of the compressed texture formats). The atlas is [member frames] times this size.

method.name: get_normal_depth_image
method.description: Returns the normal and depth atlas of the last bake of an octahedral impostor, see [member OctahedralImpostorMaterial3D.normal_depth_texture]. For a billboard, returns its normal map, in the tangent space of the quads (RGB).

method.name: get_orm_image
method.description: Returns the ORM atlas or texture of the last bake (ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic), or [code]null[/code] if [member bake_orm] was [code]false[/code].

method.name: get_sphere_center
method.description: Returns the center of the bounding sphere of the last bake, in the space of the node.

method.name: get_sphere_radius
method.description: Returns the radius of the bounding sphere of the last bake. For an octahedral impostor, it contains the geometry with a margin of a few pixels in each frame.

method.name: save
method.description: Saves the result of the last bake. Returns the mesh, or [code]null[/code] on error. For an octahedral impostor: the atlases next to [param path] as [code]<name>_albedo.png[/code], [code]<name>_normal_depth.png[/code] and [code]<name>_orm.png[/code], and a [QuadMesh] with an [OctahedralImpostorMaterial3D] at [param path]. For a billboard: the textures next to [param path] as [code]<name>_albedo.png[/code], [code]<name>_normal.png[/code] (imported as a normal map) and [code]<name>_orm.png[/code], and at [param path] a [QuadMesh] fitted to the view (or an [ArrayMesh] with the crossed planes of [constant BILLBOARD_CROSS]) with a [StandardMaterial3D]: alpha scissor, no backface culling, the billboard mode of [member billboard_mode] with [member BaseMaterial3D.billboard_keep_scale], the normal map, and the ORM texture or the mean roughness and metallic of the materials. The textures are imported as compressed textures with mipmaps. When the mesh is already loaded (e.g. baked again), it is updated in place, so the scenes that use it show the new result, and the settings of its material that aren't baked (e.g. the alpha scissor threshold, or the backlight of a billboard) are kept. The import settings of the textures changed after a previous bake are kept too.

members.member: The size in pixels of the atlases of an octahedral impostor. It's rounded down to a multiple of the [member frames], see [method get_frame_size]. For a billboard, the size of the longest side of its textures. The other side fits the shape of the object (the sides are multiples of 4 pixels).
If [code]true[/code], also bakes the ORM atlas or texture (ambient occlusion, roughness and metallic). Otherwise the impostor or billboard uses the mean roughness and metallic of the materials.
The kind of billboard baked with [constant TYPE_BILLBOARD].
The number of planes of a billboard with [constant BILLBOARD_CROSS], at equal angles around the vertical axis.
The number of views per side of the atlas of an octahedral impostor. More views give smoother transitions between them, at the cost of the resolution of each view.
The directions of the views of an octahedral impostor, see [enum OctahedralImpostorMaterial3D.Layout].
The views are rendered at this factor of the resolution of the textures and downsampled, for smooth edges.
What is baked: an octahedral impostor or a billboard.

constants.constant: Bakes an octahedral impostor: the views from many directions, drawn by an [OctahedralImpostorMaterial3D] which blends the closest ones, with parallax, depth and lighting like the object. Best for objects seen from all sides at medium distances.

Bakes a billboard: a single view of the object (or one per plane with [constant BILLBOARD_CROSS]), drawn with a [StandardMaterial3D]. Cheaper and smaller than an octahedral impostor, for objects far away or that look alike from all sides.
Represents the size of the [enum Type] enum.

A quad that turns around the vertical axis of the node toward the camera ([constant BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_FIXED_Y]), e.g. for trees. It shows the view from the front of the object, offset from the origin of the node like the object.
A quad that faces the camera ([constant BaseMaterial3D.BILLBOARD_ENABLED]), also when it's seen from above or below. It turns around the origin of the node: best for objects centered on their origin.

Static vertical planes ([member cross_planes]) that cross on the vertical axis through the center of the object, each with the view from its front, e.g. for bushes and grass. The back of the planes shows the mirrored view.
Represents the size of the [enum BillboardMode] enum.
